projects.name: AOSP fastboot
projects.capability: Perform standard BL unlocking when the device permits it
projects.scope: Pixel and other devices allowing OEM unlock
projects.wait: The standard Pixel flow has no Xiaomi-style community application/wait; preparation, confirmation, and data erasure still take time
projects.pixel9: Applicable if this device permits unlocking
projects.evidence: Official mechanism documentation; does not bypass carrier restrictions
projects.license: AOSP source, subject to upstream file-specific licenses
projects.caveat: Command duration is not total unlock-and-reboot duration

projects.name: HyperSploit

projects.wait: Waiting may still be required after successful binding

projects.name: Xiaomi-HyperOS-BootLoader-Bypass

projects.name: auto-hyperos-unlocker

projects.name: pixel-ksu-root
projects.capability: Obtain temporary root through kernel exploits while BL stays locked
projects.scope: Matching Pixel build, kernel, and payload
projects.wait: Runtime exploitation; success in seconds is not guaranteed

projects.license: NOTICE declares the CVE tree Apache-2.0; broader reuse needs file-by-file review
projects.status: Research project separating complete and incomplete exploit chains

projects.scope: Specific Qualcomm boot chains and security-service interfaces

projects.name: cheese / Adreno CVE-2025-21479
projects.capability: Adreno GPU exploit primitives and temporary-root research for specific devices
projects.scope: Unpatched Adreno A7xx and exact device/firmware adaptation
projects.wait: Neither a community waiting flow nor direct BL unlocking
projects.pixel9: Not applicable: Tensor is not the Qualcomm Adreno route
projects.evidence: On the current marble / OS3.0.5.0.VMRCNXM, compiled and ran the upstream af6c0ec probe once; output was 0 42424242, stopped after 8 seconds as planned. No kernel-log evidence confirmed unauthorized memory access.
projects.license: File-level license review not completed this round
projects.status: Historical exploit probe executed; no root obtained, BL remains locked
projects.caveat: Output matches neither upstream expectation, so exploitability or patch status cannot be determined. Complete main root code targets Quest with fixed addresses and was not executed.

projects.name: UT Tool Temp UBL
projects.capability: Vendor claims temporary Qualcomm/Xiaomi BL unlocking
projects.scope: Vendor list includes marble without proof of matching this firmware
projects.wait: Vendor claims no normal wait; this does not establish permanent unlocking
projects.evidence: Vendor FAQ describes temporary state and possible relocking after reboot; no test this round
projects.caveat: Not a confirmed route for permanently flashing Taku; not downloaded, executed, or paid for

conclusions: Low-level BL-unlock routes exist for specific models and firmware; no universal latest-version instant unlocker was found this round.
No public project confirmed for Pixel 9 / CP3A.261005.005 that bypasses disabled OEM unlocking or carrier BL restrictions was found this round.
Temporary root with locked BL exists, with Pixel 9 target information; it does not replace the unlock needed to flash a complete ROM.
The normal flow on a Pixel 9 allowing OEM unlock remains best suited to reproducible Taku development and continued upgrades.
A public Qualcomm NO_AVB PoC was newly found for current marble research; it is a real BL route worth reviewing, but prerequisites and device adaptation are not yet connected.
sourceLimits: Reviewed maintainer READMEs, support tables, FAQs, failure issues, and some source, and ran the historical cheese GPU probe once on the connected marble. Full root and BL-state modification programs were not executed.
GitHub API returned rate limits, preventing complete commit-date collection; fetch time is not treated as last-maintained time.
The physical-device probe did not establish exploitability; BL remains locked. Other maintainer test claims remain distinct from tests performed this round.
Some projects publish source without an Open Source Definition-compliant license; these are marked separately.

qualityChecks.finding: The Jz8Root compatibility table lists Xiaomi 13 under MediaTek examples; official specifications say Snapdragon 8 Gen 2.
The same table lists POCO F5 as a Dimensity example; official specifications say Snapdragon 7+ Gen 2.
The project itself records counterexamples where scans pass but modifications do not persist after cold boot.
The Pixel root support table omits October CP3A.261005.005; success claims for a July build cannot be transferred.
